<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The projects of ProjectGrid as tiles: cards (picture, featured badge, category and year, title, summary, tags,
  two links), compact cards in four columns, captions over the pictures, or a bento where the first project
  takes a big tile.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Project, ProjectLabels } from "../blocks/project-grid.types";

export type ProjectTilesProps = {
  projects: Project[];
  labels: ProjectLabels;
  layout?: "cards" | "compact" | "overlay" | "bento" | "list";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import ArticleBlock from "../components/article-block.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const { projects, labels, layout = "cards" } = defineProps<ProjectTilesProps>();
const over = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "overlay" ? true
  : ((layout as string) === "bento")
);
</script>

<template>
  <Box
    :class="
      (layout as string) === 'compact' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4'
      : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
    "
    data-slot="items"
  >
    <ArticleBlock v-for="(p, i) in projects" :key="p.id"
      :class="cn(
        'flex flex-col gap-4',
        (over ? 'relative' : 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4'),
        ((((layout as string) === 'bento') && (i === 0)) ? 'sm:col-span-2 lg:row-span-2' : '')
      )"
      testid="item"
    >
      <Box :class="(over ? 'h-full' : 'relative')">
        <MediaFrame
          :alt="p.title"
          :ratio="(((layout as string) === 'compact') ? '1/1' : (over ? '3/4' : '4/3'))"
          :class="(over ? 'h-full' : '')"
        />
        <Badge
          v-if="(p.featured && ((layout as string) !== 'compact'))"
          variant="default"
          size="default"
          class="absolute left-4 top-4"
        >
          {{ labels.featured }}
        </Badge>
      </Box>
      <Stack
        gap="2"
        align="stretch"
        :class="(over ? 'absolute right-4 bottom-4 left-4 rounded bg-background p-4' : '')"
      >
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ tpl("{0}, {1}", p.category, p.year) }}
        </Text>
        <Title :as="3" :size="(((layout as string) === 'compact') ? 'sm' : 'lg')" weight="semibold">
          {{ p.title }}
        </Title>
        <Text v-if="((layout as string) !== 'compact')" size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ p.summary }}
        </Text>
        <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'cards')">
          <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
            <Badge v-for="k in p.tags" :key="k" variant="secondary" size="sm">
              {{ k }}
            </Badge>
          </Group>
          <Group gap="4" class="pt-2">
            <MenuEntry :href="p.href" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
              {{ labels.case }}
              <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" :size="16" />
            </MenuEntry>
            <MenuEntry :href="p.href" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
              {{ labels.view }}
              <LucideIcon name="external-link" :size="16" />
            </MenuEntry>
          </Group>
        </template>
      </Stack>
    </ArticleBlock>
  </Box>
</template>
